description: This PHP class 'EmailTemplate' represents the email template system within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, providing methods for defining, parsing, exporting, and managing email templates, including handling template variables, URLs, and attachments.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: Represents an email template in SuiteCRM, providing functionality to generate, parse, export, and manage email templates and their contents, including variables, URLs, attachments, and HTML content.

methods.name: generateFieldDefsJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for macro creation based on related bean fields such as Contacts, Accounts, Leads, and Prospects.

methods.name: generateFieldDefsJS2
methods.description: An alternative method to generate JavaScript field definitions, including additional bean types like Events.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the email template as a summary.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates SQL query for exporting email templates, delegating to create_new_list_query.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Placeholder for subclasses to fill additional list view fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates the email body and user-related details when displaying a detailed view.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Placeholder for additional parent data fill-ins.

methods.name: parse_tracker_urls
methods.description: Parses URLs in email content and replaces placeholders with tracking URLs.

methods.name: _preg_match_tracker_url
methods.description: Helper to match URL patterns for tracking in the email content.

methods.name: parse_email_template
methods.description: Parses dynamic variables within email templates, replacing placeholders with actual data from related beans and user context.

methods.name: parse_template_bean
methods.description: Loads bean data into template variables for substitution within a template string.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates implementation of specific interfaces like ACL.

methods.name: getTypeOptionsForSearch
methods.description: Provides searchable type options for email templates.

methods.name: is_used_by_email_marketing
methods.description: Checks whether the current email template is associated with any email marketing campaigns.

methods.name: cleanBean
methods.description: Prepares the template for saving by replacing variable placeholders with hashes.

methods.name: storeVariables
methods.description: Stores variables in the template with their md5 hashes for later replacement.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the email template, including custom logic before saving.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the email template by ID and repairs content links and images.

methods.name: addDomainToRelativeImagesSrc
methods.description: Replaces relative image URLs with absolute URLs based on site configuration.

methods.name: repairMozaikClears
methods.description: Fixes specific HTML issues related to TinyMCE editor content.

methods.name: repairEntryPointImages
methods.description: Converts embedded image URLs to public URLs, making images accessible remotely.

methods.name: makePublicImage
methods.description: Moves images to a public folder to be accessible by URL.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments linked to this email template.
